product_one_liner.value: Mohawk Global provides businesses with international and domestic freight and logistics services, customs brokerage, and trade-compliance consulting, supported by GlobalLink shipment tracking and visibility.
product_one_liner.notes: The services page describes international logistics, domestic cargo, and trade consulting; the GlobalLink page adds shipment tracking and review of customs entries. Together these establish the service offering and its business customers.

pricing_page.notes: The official Rates URL shows only a page heading/image and no public price list or plans; the homepage’s displayed service navigation likewise offers service categories rather than pricing. I therefore treat this as no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Mohawk Global’s case study identifies Umbra as using its customs-brokerage services, and another case study identifies Frazer & Jones as a customer outsourcing inbound transportation. | named_customers.0: The case study names Umbra and states that it uses Mohawk Global customs-brokerage services. | named_customers.1: The case-study index summary names Frazer & Jones and describes its inbound transportation relationship with Mohawk Global.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile states a company size of 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company’s official location page explicitly labels Syracuse as its headquarters. | hq_country: Mohawk Global identifies its headquarters as Syracuse and gives its shipping address in North Syracuse, New York, United States.

founded_year.notes: Mohawk Global’s About Us page states that it was founded in 1993.

eng_blog.notes: The Knowledge Center index organizes material as tariff news, global news, trade translation, case studies, white papers, general articles, and market updates. Its listed posts are industry and customer-facing content rather than multiple engineer-authored technical articles about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Mohawk Global’s public API portal describes programmatic access to company data and documents numerous production endpoints, meeting the public developer-documentation criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job-board inventory lists 31 open roles and displays their titles; none is an AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, research-scientist, applied-scientist, or computer-vision role.

compliance_certs.notes: The company’s legal Privacy Policy includes an Information Security section but does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications; its last-modified date is old, so this negative is less certain.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company funding profile reports “No funding” and says Mohawk Global has never raised funding before, so the schema’s no-round stage value is “none.”

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no funding and states the company has never raised; accordingly it did not raise in the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live ADP job posting is titled Senior Account Executive (Freight Forwarding, Customs Brokerage) and classifies the role under Sales, so the company is hiring an account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The corporate-news archive’s latest identified MGCX service-expansion announcement is dated Dec. 4, 2025, before the six-month window. Its Aug. 2026 GlobalLink case study describes a customized solution for a particular customer, not a public launch of a product or major feature. No launch-type announcement within the requested window was identified in the readable company news index.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current executive-team roster is checkable and the verified profile shows CTO Richard Schuyler’s start date as March 2025, before the Nov. 9, 2025–Nov. 9, 2026 window. No C-level/VP join or departure within the window was found; the negative relies partly on the roster and checked announcement/profile record.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Marketing Operations Specialist posting explicitly names Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, and Qualified.com as tools used for marketing campaigns, automation, data, lead capture, and engagement. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Mohawk Global marketing-operations job posting explicitly names Salesforce as a platform used in the company’s marketing operations. | crm_stack_signal.1: The Mohawk Global marketing-operations job posting explicitly names HubSpot as a platform used in the company’s marketing operations. | crm_stack_signal.2: The Mohawk Global marketing-operations job posting explicitly names Clay as a platform used in the company’s marketing operations. | crm_stack_signal.3: The Mohawk Global marketing-operations job posting explicitly names Qualified.com as a platform used in the company’s marketing operations.
